VERDICT goal: the goal is to make crew complete --land refuse, before it merges, a head behind the run's worktree; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2692-2705 reads the worktree head and refuses before merge.land runs.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when lists three cases, a negative control, base/head population arms and ruff cleanliness; the manifest and the logs under the run directory record each, with base and head failing on the same single pre-existing id.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew_run_commands.py, tests/test_a_land_refuses_a_head_behind_its_worktree.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/a-land-refuses-a-head-behind-its-worktree.html; every path in the two commits is one of these.
VERDICT manifest: read; it reports 3 cases at 3b95dc020, the negative control red, base and head arms at 1 failed/373 passed with one shared id, and names gate-head.log, base-arm.log, head-arm.log and negative-control.log.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against 8d5f2f918; 3b95dc020 adds the pre-merge comparison and its three-case test, c6ecadc7e adds the evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2600 (_land_a_promoted_run under crew complete --land), reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:_land_once (invokes crew complete --land through _land_command), reckon/crew/merge.py:_is_ancestor and _rev_parse (reused, not redefined)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2687-2705 refuses with the reviewed head, worktree head and merge command before merge_module.land is called, matching the goal.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head.log ends EXIT=0 with 7 passed, base-arm.log and head-arm.log both end EXIT=1 with the identical single failing id, and negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 on the third-commit case.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the two commits touch only the three declared write paths; the 16 deleted lines in reckon/crew_run_commands.py are the inline resume_merge moved into _merge_command.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_land_refuses_a_head_behind_its_worktree.py:129-149 fails when the guard is removed, as negative-control.log records, and its remote assertion is independent of the input revision.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the guard follows the surrounding step-reporting idiom at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2653-2710 and names nothing by plan, ticket or version.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the guard reuses reckon/crew/merge.py:_is_ancestor and _rev_parse rather than adding a second reachability definition, and no existing merge-command builder was found, so _merge_command only factors the inline construction.
